data.gender_notes: Mireille is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the French word ‘mire’ which means ‘to marvel’ and ‘elle’ meaning ‘she’. This name was given to a saint born in the 13th century who was famous for her acts of kindness and charity. The name Mireille carries the meaning “Marvellous recruit” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Mireille usually hope their child will grow to embody marvellous recruit and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mireille total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
